title: Signature SwiftInfer — What it is
description: Signature SwiftInfer is Manon's original local-inference engine: a tiny, dependency-free core that runs quantized models on whatever silicon is available, with automatic hardware detection (CPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) and honest speed reporting. It is made by Signature Systems (Justin Addam Higgins) and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux.
